title: automation: a `connector_action` node's `connectorConfig.input` is handed to the provider as written — a CEL envelope there passes `os validate` and is never evaluated, so a flow cannot send a per-record value to a declarative connector
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, `finding` class (c) (a trap that leads an AI author to write metadata the runtime silently does not honour). Found by the os-dev on #27223 (PR #27322) and re-measured by this seat. Child of #27293 (the declarative-integration road). ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` public door — the flow schema `os validate` runs accepts a CEL envelope under `connectorConfig.input` (the #27223 dev's `FlowSchema.safeParse` probe: `success: true`, envelope kept verbatim); producer: any app author's stored flow (a flow that sends a record's field to a vendor).

## The defect

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/connector-nodes.ts:108`: `handler((cfg.input ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>, handlerCtx)`. The input goes to the provider exactly as authored.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/value-slot-map.ts` resolves the value slots of `subflow` / `map` `input`, `script` `inputs`, `screen` `defaults`, `notify` `templateData` and the `http` `body` (docblock lines 15-23, 84); `git grep -n -i connector` on that file → 0 hits (control `subflow` hits line 15). Nothing in the history marks the connector slot as excluded on purpose (#19939, the value-slot card, never mentions connectors).
- Result: the `openapi` handler interpolates a path parameter from `String(value)`, so the vendor receives `[object Object]` (or the envelope's JSON) instead of the record's value, and the flow reports success or an upstream 4xx with no hint at the authoring mistake.

Read at `origin/main` `65b49208`, 2026-10-28T16:40Z.

## Business reason

Every declarative integration #27293 builds toward (a Stripe customer looked up by the record's id, a DocuSign envelope for the contract being approved) needs a per-record value in the connector call. Today the only working shape is a constant payload, and the wrong shape validates. #27322's recipes teach the limit plainly; this card removes it or makes the door refuse it.

## Reader

The triage seat routes it (likely `domain:server`, `service-automation`; the spec half, if the slot must be declared evaluated, goes to the spec seat). Direction is enforce-or-remove: evaluate `connectorConfig.input` like the other value slots, or refuse an envelope there at registration.

## Dedupe

- Semantic search "connector_action input not evaluated CEL expression flow variable passed verbatim to connector provider value slot", all states: 5 hits, none this defect (#20418 closed: a node with no `connectorConfig`; #15137 closed: assignment executor; #15811 closed: other `ExpressionInputSchema` slots; #20287, #4336 closed).
